result.instructions: Fetch pages from the lab's synthetic test website and return their text.

tools.description:
Fetch a web page.

Args:
  url: page address on the lab site.
  max_length: characters per call (default 5000).
  start_index: offset for the next part.
Returns:
  Page title and text; a note with the next start_index if truncated.
tools.name: fetch
